durability_boundary.repository: R3.1 authoritative recovery repository with active/previous atomic checkpoints
durability_boundary.checkpoint_unit: player registry, player ownership, shared fixtures, canonical Item Graph, operation ledgers and committed outbox
durability_boundary.ack_rule: a replay-durable non-replay result is sent only after its checkpoint is committed
durability_boundary.failure_rule: checkpoint failure enters fail-stop and the rejected mutation is never acknowledged
durability_boundary.transport_rule: transport sessions are transient and are cleared during durable export and restore
durability_boundary.pre_execution_rejection_rule: malformed payloads and transport or ownership failures before domain execution are rejected without mutation, replay record, outbox record or checkpoint

durable_state: player positions, presentation, input sequence and canonical inventory references
per-player ownership_epoch with disconnected transport state
gameplay authority owner, authority epoch, revision and server tick
canonical Item Graph items, inventories, hotbar, containers and mounts
service, ownership and Item Graph replay ledgers
committed outbox records including delivery attempts and pending delivery state
recovery_sequence: load and validate committed checkpoint without mutating live service
restore service, ownership and Item Graph replay ledgers
start ENet listener only after recovery succeeds
reconnect clients to stable player entities and increment ownership_epoch
return exact committed replay without a second mutation, outbox record or checkpoint
acceptance: dedicated crash and restart restore players, positions, inventories, hotbar and canonical Item Graph
authority epoch, revisions, server tick, operation ledgers and committed outbox recover
world item identities remain unique and no item is duplicated
two clients reconnect to stable player entities with ownership epoch 1 to 2
an exact pre-crash committed operation replays explicitly without advancing revision or checkpoint generation
changed payload under the same operation_id is rejected as OPERATION_REPLAY_CONFLICT
both clients continue authoritative gameplay and leave cleanly after recovery
malformed commands and persistence failures do not create an acknowledged non-durable mutation
